name: Password Sign-In Succeeds
summary: The user submits valid password credentials, the server authenticates the durable identity, establishes a normal session, and returns the resolved landing destination.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active, fully configured password-enabled durable identity is ready for sign-in

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Prepared test-user email resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Valid password generated by the test setup manager and resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

serverInteraction.intent: Authenticate the identified durable identity with the submitted password, establish the application session, and resolve the landing destination.

postconditions.expression: the durable identity remains active and unlocked and records a successful login while the resolved application landing destination is active

sourceReferences.note: PasswordSignInAsync completes successful authentication through CompleteSignInToAppAsync, updates LastLogin, and records PasswordAuthenticationSucceeded.
Implementation review confirms the generated proxy, REST endpoint, AuthenticationFlowService, typed handler and sign-in manager path for successful password sign-in.
